name: Dusklight
description: Dusklight for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port on RADV (Aurora, Dawn WebGPU, SDL3). Bring your own disc image.
author: Gary Riches
release_notes:
Texture packs with .dds files, and a folder you can actually copy them into. Built from upstream Dusklight revision 34a144a493, as v0.2.0 was.

Fixed
- .dds textures saved as sRGB now load. Many export tools tag colour textures as sRGB (BC7, BC1, BC3, RGBA8, BGRA8), and those files were refused. They are read like their plain versions now.
- FTP can upload into the texture folder. The game made texture_replacements for its own user only, so an upload into it was refused. It is opened to the FTP server at every start.

Texture packs
- Put files named the way Dolphin names them (tex1_256x128_e6a4c7be9bf48305_14.dds) in /data/homebrew/PPSA99305/userdata/TwilitRealm/Dusklight/texture_replacements/, in subfolders if you like, or in the textures/ folder of a .dusk mod. Start the game once first: it makes the folder.
- .png and .dds both work. A .dds may be uncompressed 32-bit RGBA or BGRA, BC1 (DXT1), BC3 (DXT5), BC5 or BC7, with or without mipmaps.

Limits
- BC2 (DXT3), BC4, BC6H and ASTC .dds files are not loaded.
- A compressed texture's width and height must be multiples of 4.
- A mipmapped compressed texture whose smaller levels are not multiples of 4 logs a warning about its preview; the texture itself still draws.
- Textures are matched by name to the disc's own textures. A pack made for another region's disc may not match the GameCube USA disc.

Install or update
- Unpack Dusklight-PS5-v0.3.0.zip. It holds one folder, PPSA99305.
- Copy that folder to the console as /data/homebrew/PPSA99305/, over the old one if you have an earlier version. Your disc image, saves and settings in that folder are left alone.
- New install only: copy your own GameCube disc image (.iso or .ciso) into the same folder.
- Start "Dusklight" from the home screen.

No game data is in this download. The README has the details.

Not verified
Seen on one console with three small test files in the loose folder: BC7 tagged sRGB with mipmaps, DXT5 and uncompressed RGBA, all drawn in the game. A real texture pack has not been tried, nor a .dds inside a .dusk. The released program is the one that was tested. Sound, the full controller mapping and long sessions remain unconfirmed.

Source
A built title is under GPL-3.0. SOURCE.txt in the zip names the revision of every part it was built from; this port's is f4f12bd.
